scope: Live Blender execution of the read-only capture adapter; tool mechanics only. No anatomical fit, motion or gate acceptance.

blender.form: Blender 5.2.1 LTS as the bpy Python module (python3.13, PYTHONPATH=/tmp/claude-0/bpy52); no standalone blender binary in this container
blender.equivalence_note: Same Blender release as recorded for the laptop in earlier V11 receipts; the CLI form `blender --background --python` was not executed here. The adapter now also accepts --blend for bpy-module use.

verified_items.armature_selection: Decoy armature with identical bone names ignored; explicit name selects the intended rig; mesh/absent names refused.
verified_items.world_coordinates_and_units: Armature object translated, rotated 90 deg and scaled x2; scene unit scale 0.01; rest and evaluated points match hand-derived world metres to 1e-6 m.
verified_items.rest_vs_evaluated: Rest geometry unchanged while evaluated pose differs; evaluated tibia tail matches an independent FK chain at frames 1, 6.5 (subframe) and 11 to 1e-5 m.
verified_items.offset_marker: Armature-parented joint marker deliberately 40 mm from the tibia head measured at its own position (0.96,0,1.00) m, not at a bone head; bone-parented marker follows the evaluated femur at the expected 60 mm.
verified_items.known_90deg_rotation: Tibia rotation relative to femur measures 90.000 deg at frame 11 and 49.5 deg at subframe 6.5 (linear keys) through a COPY_ROTATION constraint from an untagged helper.
verified_items.drivers: Simple-expression driver from a keyed property evaluated (femur 30 deg / 16.5 deg). A Python-expression driver is blocked without auto-execution; the capture reports automatic_python_execution_failed=True and provenance is not PASS.
verified_items.frame_restoration: Saved frame 3 subframe 0.25 restored after successful sampling and after a mid-sampling failure (invalid evidence image).
verified_items.source_preservation: Fixture .blend SHA-256 and mtime unchanged; capture records equal before/after hashes.
verified_items.time_base: Sample times use fps/fps_base (29.97 fps); Blender stores fps_base in single precision, compared at 1e-7 relative.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Landmark objects were read from bpy.data.objects, so landmarks from other scenes in the same file leaked into captures.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Landmarks read from the active scene only; armature and joint markers outside the active scene are refused.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Explicit metres-per-unit was never compared with the scene unit scale; a wrong conversion (1.0 for a 0.01 m/BU scene) still produced units PASS.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Capture records unit_scale_consistent (single-precision relative comparison; None when the scene declares no unit). Analyser: inconsistent -> FAIL, unknown -> UNVERIFIED.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Adapter could only run inside the Blender CLI (no way to open the audit file from the bpy module; argv parsing assumed a "--" separator).
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Optional --blend opens the saved audit copy; argv falls back to sys.argv[1:].

scale_evidence: glTF 2.0 linear unit is the metre; importer produced scene METRIC scale_length 1.0 (unit_scale_consistent=True)
Mesh stature 1.8200 m with soles at z=0 matches the generator TARGET_HEIGHT finish step; not used as primary evidence
character_static_capture.interpretation: Expected reference gap: the 67-control runtime rig contains none of the 206 anat_ reference bones (coverage 0/206). Provenance, units, identity and geometry integrity pass.
character_static_capture.additional_object_finding: The r95 BARE export also contains an unparented 42-vertex "Icosphere" mesh object (unit radius at the origin); it is not part of the character and should be reviewed before any runtime promotion.

repository_tests.command: PYTHONPATH=<bpy52 numpy> python3.13 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p "test_*.py"
repository_tests.note: System python3.11 lacks numpy; running with it adds four import errors (o2_body, axilla_edge_localization, shoulder_yoke_probe, shoulder_yoke_rest_length) that are environment-only.

addenda.reason: Running the capture on the real 206-bone master exposed further defects.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: rigid_matrix orthogonality tolerance 1e-6 rejected valid single-precision Blender bone matrices (2.5e-6 measured on 5 mm bones).
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: RIGID_TOLERANCE = 1e-5 for orthogonality and determinant; real shear (1e-2) and reflections still fail.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: A derived relative-rotation error raised out of analyze_capture instead of failing sample_integrity.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Errors recorded as pose errors; sample_integrity evaluated after the rotation loop.
defects_found_and_fixed.note: The guard test passed before the fix because invalid inputs are caught earlier; the crash path was reproduced live on the a002 capture.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: capture.json was written only after analysis, so an analysis crash discarded the Blender evidence.
